summary: Degraded sweep. No wave plan was staged and this dispatch had no factory execution telemetry (agent_task, step_execution, gate decisions) and no prior factory_capacity_plan rows. Every measured metric is null, so none is reported as zero. The recommended cap of 1 concurrent wave is a conservative default, not a measured value. Rationalization should not raise concurrency above 1 until a later sweep measures throughput, gate first-pass rate and human reviewer capacity.

rationale: There is no measured throughput, gate first-pass rate, escalation rate or reviewer queue depth to support running waves in parallel.
Human bottleneck: SME reviews and the two-signature gates in the baseline profile do not parallelize well. G-DA, G-02, G-DE-2, G-V3 and G-DP-2 each require minimum_approvals = 2 from distinct roles.
Contention rule 4 (never sacrifice quality gates for throughput) favours serial waves until capacity is measured.
